## 📰 General changes and notes

Summary of changes here!

<details open>
<summary>Github Commits :octocat:</summary>
<blockquote>

- chore: bcc
- Blacklist Packing Tapes and Ars Nouveau's Dowsing Rod from Eternal Stella (#4424)
- The blacklisted items disappear when used instead of being eternal.
- Tested on my server running 8.1 modpack version.
- Fix rabbit_food tag: keep vanilla entries and use melon_slice (#4430)
- * Change replace value from true to false in rabbit_food.json
- * Replace melon with melon_slice in rabbit_food.json
- fix: improve Turkish quest translations and terminology (#4431)
- * fix: improve Turkish quest translations and terminology
- * fix: resolve remaining Turkish quest terminology inconsistencies
- Fix CuBee quest icon (#4433)
- Disable all silver processing recipes added by Mekanism: More Machine (#4438)
- Hide MI Replicator from JEI (#4455)
- The Replicator from MI has its recipe removed and should be hidden from JEI to avoid clutter.
- Create Addon Quest (#4456)
- Quest Chapter for Trains, Ars Creo, Aquatic Ambitions, Dragons Plus, and Crafts and Additions
- Mitigate Ice and Fire pile duplication via Building Gadgets 2 (#4462)
- new att rpc setup (#4459)
- Update ender_dragon.json
- Update unobtainium.json
- Update vibranium.json
- Update utilitarian-common.toml
- Update tags.js
- chore: modlist</blockquote>

</details>
